posts.title: How to Choose Custom Cosmetic Packaging Without Over-Specifying the Box
posts.summary: Custom cosmetic packaging often fails not because the box is too simple, but because the sourcing brief is unclear. For beauty brands, the most useful packaging discussion usually starts with product dimensions, retail channel, protection needs, surface finish, insert structure and the desired unboxing style. For skincare jars, creams, serums and beauty sets, buyers should define product fit, brand expression and production review before requesting a quote.

posts.title: Rigid Gift Boxes: What Buyers Should Confirm Before Sampling
posts.summary: Rigid gift boxes are often used for premium cosmetics, electronics, wellness products, holiday gifts and retail sets. Before sampling, buyers should confirm product dimensions and weight, box structure, insert requirement, surface direction and sales channel. MUGE PACKAGING develops custom rigid gift boxes and paper packaging structures for global B2B buyers.

posts.title: Paper Tube Packaging: A Practical Option for Premium Retail Products
posts.summary: Paper tube packaging is widely used for cosmetics, tea, candles, fragrance, small gifts and specialty retail products. Buyers comparing paper tubes with other packaging structures should review product display impact, weight suitability, closure style and surface finish. MUGE PACKAGING supports custom paper tube packaging by diameter, height, cap structure, material, printing and finishing options.
